description: Product must have a clear name or common/generic name displayed on the package.
failure_message: Product name is missing or not declared on the package.
recommendation: Ensure the product name is clearly printed on the principal display panel.

description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be declared.
recommendation: Declare the full name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer as applicable.

description: Complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be mentioned.
recommendation: Include the full postal address including city, state, and PIN code.

description: Net quantity of the commodity in standard units of weight, measure, or number must be declared.
failure_message: Net quantity is missing or not declared.
recommendation: Declare net quantity in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L, or number).

description: Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes must be declared.
recommendation: Print the MRP inclusive of all taxes in Indian Rupees (₹).

description: Date of manufacture or packing must be mentioned on the package.
failure_message: Manufacturing or packing date is not declared.
recommendation: Include the month and year of manufacture or packing.

description: Expiry date or best-before date must be mentioned where applicable.
failure_message: Expiry or best-before date is missing.
recommendation: Declare the expiry date or 'Best Before' period from the date of manufacture.

description: Customer care / consumer complaint contact details should be provided.
failure_message: Consumer care or complaint contact information is missing.
recommendation: Provide a consumer helpline number, email, or postal address for complaints.

description: Country of origin must be declared, especially for imported goods.
failure_message: Country of origin is not declared.
recommendation: Mention the country where the product was manufactured or assembled.

description: List of ingredients in descending order of composition should be declared for food products.
recommendation: List all ingredients in descending order of their proportion by weight or volume.

description: For imported products, importer's name and address must be declared.
failure_message: Importer details are missing for what appears to be an imported product.
recommendation: Include the name and address of the importer on the package.

description: Name and address of the packer if different from the manufacturer.
recommendation: If the packer is different from the manufacturer, declare packer details.

description: Any claims on the product (e.g., 'organic', 'sugar-free') should be verifiable.
failure_message: Product claims are present but may need verification.
recommendation: Ensure all product claims are substantiated and comply with advertising standards.

description: A valid barcode or unique product identifier should be present on the package.
failure_message: No barcode or product identifier found.
recommendation: Include a standard barcode (EAN-13, UPC) for product identification and traceability.

description: Product category or type should be identifiable from the label.
failure_message: Product category is not clearly identifiable.
recommendation: Mention the product category or type for consumer clarity.
